findings.correction: Reject duplicate object keys during JSON decoding and retain a fresh synthetic duplicate-key control. Independent terminal parser also stays strict.
findings.finding: JSON object duplicate keys are silently last-wins, so conflicting code/span/label keys can be accepted contrary to frozen ambiguous-output refusal policy.

findings.correction: Block handled asynchronous signals across child launch and process assignment, restore the mask after the handle is retained, and retain a synthetic pending-signal/ownership control. Do not start any real child to test this.
findings.finding: Raising signal handlers remain active during Popen and before assignment to process. A handled signal after launch but before assignment can reach finally with process=None although an owned child exists.
